items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: When you played with Louie Armstrong, he followed you -- you were the more important one, weren't you, on those early records? I think so.

ctx.x: Well, I wouldn't have thought of Trixie and Clara --
Right, now, as the '20s went by, as it got older, and towards -- in the era, in the time when you were making records with Louie Armstrong, '26 and '27.
That was 1924 when Louie was with Fletcher Henderson in New York, right?
